snip.t: Epigastric or left upper quadrant pain radiating to the back (a dull, boring pain from retroperitoneal and coeliac plexus invasion) that is eased by leaning forward or curling up and worse at night.
snip.s: Pancreatic Head Cancer and Periampullary Tumours: Whipple Procedure and Palliati

snip.t: Pain: a stepwise approach starting with paracetamol and NSAIDs, then weak and strong opioids (tramadol), neuromodulators (pregabalin, amitriptyline, SSRIs), antioxidants, coeliac plexus block, and endoscopic or surgical drainage.
snip.s: Acute and Chronic Pancreatitis: Causes, Diagnosis, Severity Scoring and Manageme

snip.t: Pain control: opioids and a coeliac plexus block (percutaneous or at surgery) or neurolytic block; palliative radiotherapy.
snip.s: Pancreatic Head Cancer and Periampullary Tumours: Whipple Procedure and Palliati
